title: Jonah and the Letters
author: Beatrix Pemberton
blurb: Hazel Coldharbour, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, has spent seven years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the bakery lease runs out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
